_comment: Civic Education Content -- Secondary Teachers' Diploma syllabus, Years 1-2.
First typeset 2026-10-12.
MATRIX NUMBERS. The manuscript's numbers run on and slip: '1.3 1.4.' on Legal Systems,
topics 1.4-1.5 numbered one ahead of their sub-topics, a competence numbered 1.7.2,
Gender and Development's sub-topics running 1.13.3 after 1.12.3, and in Year 2 the
topics numbered 2.1, 2.3, 2.4 (no 2.2) with Globalisation's sub-topic as 3.4.1 and
competence 3.1.1.2. renumberMatrix counts them afresh from the table's structure:
Year 1 has 16 topics (1.1 Introduction to Civic Education ... 1.16 Trade), Year 2 three
(2.1 Regional and International Organizations, 2.2 Globalisation, 2.3 International
Relations). The manuscript's typed contents list agrees for Year 1; for Year 2 it
lists 2.1, 2.3, 2.4 -- the same slip as the matrix.
YEAR HEADINGS. 'YEAR ONE' is typed three times and 'YEAR TWO' twice; the engine keeps
the one over each matrix (one level page per year).
KEY COMPETENCES (publisher's request, 2026-10-12, as for History Content). Year 1 had
no Digital Literacy, Entrepreneurship or Environmental Sustainability rows; each is
added in Year 2's order, drawn from the Year 1 matrix (see each _why). Year 2's
Emotional Intelligence repeated Financial Literacy's descriptor as its third line; it
is replaced from matrix 2.3.4. No competence, activity or expected standard in the
matrix is rewritten. The new wording should be confirmed by CDC.
ISBN: none given; the imprint shows a blank ISBN line, as in the other syllabuses.

pageBreakBefore._why: The Year 2 Key Competences ran on under the last rows of the Year 1 matrix; it opens Year 2 on a fresh page, as the Year 1 table opens Year 1. Anchored on the 'YEAR TWO' line typed above it (that line itself is then dropped as a repeat of the YEAR TWO page over the matrix).
